field.label: Checkout Style
field.comment: Default (2-Step) = the stock Magento Knockout checkout (shipping step, then payment). Single-Page Instant = the fast checkout that paints the form immediately and populates data in the background. You can always force the stock checkout on a single request with ?fastcheckout=0.

field.label: Link Guest Orders to Existing Accounts
field.comment: When a guest checks out with an email that already belongs to a registered account (same website), attach the order to that account so it appears in the customer's order history. On by default. Note: this associates the order by email match alone, without the shopper logging in.

field.label: Enable Google Places Autocomplete
field.comment: Suggest and auto-fill the shipping address from Google Places as the shopper types the street. Requires a Google Maps JavaScript API key with the Places library enabled. The module's CSP whitelist already allows the Google Maps hosts.

field.label: Google Maps API Key
field.comment: A Google Maps JavaScript API key with the Places library enabled. Stored in plain text on purpose — a client-side Maps key is served to the browser in the script URL, so it is not a secret (secure it with HTTP-referrer + API restrictions in Google Cloud instead). Leave blank to reuse the Amasty Address Autocomplete key (amasty_address_autocomplete/general/google_api_key) if that extension is installed.
